mechanism.claim: A completed European-session rotation in which the cyclical Swedish krona weakens while the Swiss franc and Japanese yen strengthen measures broad risk-off pressure with the common dollar component directionally cancelled. In a high-variation BTC regime, risk-off pressure maps short BTC and risk-on relief maps long BTC for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of the three-leg risk-pressure median
mechanism.why_distinct: SHRR introduces USDSEK and combines one cyclical currency with two haven currencies under opposite score orientations. HVDBR measured common six-pair dollar breadth, DFSR a signed dollar factor, SERBR GBP-minus-EUR regional beta, and MXRBR one EM currency; all are terminal and no event set or control is reused.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: BTC completed prior-24h realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one sparse weekday 16:05 UTC external risk-rotation clock is absent from Gross9 primitives.

features.fx_session: bars_polygon interval=1m rows for USDSEK, USDCHF, and USDJPY with 08:00<=UTC time<16:00 on one UTC weekday
features.fx_session_valid: each pair has at least 450 distinct minutes, first timestamp no later than 08:05, last no earlier than 15:55, finite positive OHLC; no imputation
features.pair_zscores: each session log return standardized against its own at most 90 strictly prior valid sessions, minimum 60, current excluded; prior sample std positive
features.risk_scores: USDSEK z-score, negative USDCHF z-score, and negative USDJPY z-score; positive means risk-off
features.risk_pressure: cross-sectional median of all three finite risk scores; strict nonzero
features.risk_pressure_rank: strict-prior midrank of absolute risk_pressure over at most 90 prior valid sessions, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.70
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared completed-hour BTC log returns over 24 hours ending at decision)
features.volatility_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 valid decision days, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact weekday D 16:00 UTC after FX session and BTC variation complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.completed_btc: hash-bound completed-hour BTC source through 2026-08-01 for pre-entry variation only
source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no symbols, orientation, session, pressure definition, rank, side, hold, clock, volatility, or subset repair.
